subheading: INDICATIONS FOR ADMISSION FOR PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASES
subheading_corrected: INDICATIONS FOR ADMISSION FOR PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASES
text:
Indications for admission
- Uncertain diagnosis
- Intolerance of oral medication or non-response to outpatient therapy
- Presence of a pelvic mass
- Presence of an intrauterine device
- Upper abdominal pain
- Non-adherence to therapy
- Pregnancy
- Nulliparity
